problem:
Title: Real Semi-Inner Product Space is Complex Semi-Inner Product Space

Let $\struct{V, \innerprod \cdot \cdot}$ be a [[Definition:Real Semi-Inner Product Space|real semi-inner product space]].

Then $\struct{V, \innerprod \cdot \cdot}$ is a [[Definition:Complex Semi-Inner Product Space|complex semi-inner product Space]].
